original_test_intent: Verify the SKU Number string of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 enclosure matches the approved chassis product/BOM identity or an explicitly supported absent value and remains stable after reboot, distinct from Type 1 system and Type 2 board SKU fields.
original_method: Capture complete Type 3 records, verify structure/version applicability through the variable contained-element area, bind the intended enclosure by serial/asset/type/BOM, compare its SKU Number with the approved chassis identity, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the enclosure SKU/absence rule, target record and reboot plan. Record-aware extraction and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved chassis SKU or supported-absence value
Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 3 formatted-length/element-layout rule
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and preserve complete Type 3 records plus errors.
Do not confuse Type 1, Type 2 and Type 3 SKU fields or assume the first Type 3 record.
Validate that the SKU string index is present after any variable contained-element data before reading it; reject malformed/truncated records.
Do not silently normalize a chassis product mismatch, blank or placeholder into acceptance.
Stop on ambiguity, unexpected absence, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3/tool/BOM evidence, validate field applicability, bind the enclosure and compare its SKU before/after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, substitute system/board SKU or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected chassis SKU or supported absence, target enclosure and normalization rules.
Resolve chassis product/BOM discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant but grep loses exact enclosure and formatted-record provenance, hides errors and cannot distinguish absent field from empty/malformed data.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 3 output with tool/errors, validate structure layout, select the enclosure using correlated identity and extract only its SKU Number.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 3 SKU Number scope, chassis script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify SMBIOS version and Type 3 formatted layout including the variable element array, bind the enclosure, compare the raw SKU string with the approved chassis/BOM identity and govern unsupported absence explicitly across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 3 implementations that include the SKU Number string-index field.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/parser, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 SKU Number field/layout, approved chassis BOM and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds layout/applicability checks and exact enclosure identity without changing the source field.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected SKU or supported-absence rule and enclosure mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may omit this optional/version-dependent field; absence must not be confused with parser truncation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific SKU alias or supported absence only with exact SMBIOS/layout applicability and enclosure/BOM identity documented; raw values must be retained.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected SKU/absence rule, field applicability, enclosure/BOM mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 record plus layout-aware SKU comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently target the Type 3 chassis SKU; optional field availability is not contradictory intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and safe read path are clear; expected identity and applicability are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds enclosure identity, complete evidence and absence-versus-malformation checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains field separation and supported-absence handling while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds variable-layout/formatted-length validation specific to the late Type 3 SKU field.

review_improvement: Prevents a SKU from another structure, a truncated Type 3 record or an unapproved blank/alias from satisfying chassis identity validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: With approved chassis identity and layout inputs, all collection, parsing, comparison and reboot steps are software-controlled; formal engineer verdict remains separate.
